$schema.description: The architecture-report format's shape, named by the phax release that last changed it (not necessarily the release that wrote this file): https://docs.phax.run/schemas/architecture-report/<X.Y.Z>.json

body.description: Markdown for the agent to read. phax prints it as is, before the parts, and never parses it.
body.title: nonEmptyString

id.description: The part's stable id, a kebab-case slug unique within the report. A phax.json bound names a part by it.

name.description: The part's name, shown to the agent and never interpreted by phax.
name.title: nonEmptyString

description.description: One sentence on what the part holds.
description.title: nonEmptyString

items.description: Checked by phax's parser: no leading /, backslash, brace, empty, . or .. segment, and ** only as a whole segment.

globs.description: The files the part holds, as globs: working-tree-root-relative POSIX paths, matched case-sensitively and the same on every host. `**` as a whole segment matches zero or more segments, `*` matches zero or more characters within a segment, `?` matches one character other than `/`. A leading dot is not special. Every other character is literal, `[`, `]` and `!` included. Braces are refused. A glob covers files: write `src/core/**` to cover a directory.

parts.description: Checked by phax's parser: no two parts share an id.
